about_the_game:
Ride through a forgotten South, where revolvers clash with revolution.
This is not the American West—this is post-unification Southern Italy, where fading nobles, ex-priests, bandits, and bounty hunters fight for power in a land torn between history and myth.

In this Spaghetti Western-inspired narrative action game, you'll take on the role of Veronica, a Russian noblewoman who runs a casino in Naples and moonlights as a bounty hunter. Alongside her eccentric gang—including a pleasure-loving priest, a noble bored of wealth, and a seasoned brigand—you’ll choose contracts, face morally grey decisions, and uncover conspiracies that bind the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies to its ruins.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:

  • 🔫 Cinematic Shootouts & Duels: Tactical third-person gunplay inspired by Spaghetti Western classics.

  • 🎭 Multiple Playable Characters: Choose from Veronica, Aloisio the priest, Totonno the brigand, and Francesco the noble.

  • 🌍 Historical-Fiction Setting: Explore stylized versions of Naples, Paestum, Salerno, and rural Southern villages reimagined as a lawless frontier.

  • 🐴 Open-ended Missions: Work for Italians, Borbonics, or play both sides—your loyalties are yours to sell.

  • 🎵 Original Soundtrack blending Morricone-esque cues with Southern Italian folk.

  • 🗺️ Rich Dialogue & Choices: Interact with rebels, clergy, aristocrats, and outlaws through branching dialogue trees.

  • 💥 Mini-games & Side Activities: From casino dancing to cannon testing, every location has its secrets.

  • This is a playable slice of Olive Raiders, giving you a first taste of its narrative, characters, and tactical shootouts.

    In this demo, you’ll play as:

    • Veronica, a Russian noblewoman and bounty hunter

    • Aloisio, an ex-priest with a flair for pistols and poetry

    🌆 Playable Areas:

    • The neat village of san Mauro La Bruca

    • The town of Piaggine

    • The ancient ruins of Paestum

    • The port city of Salerno

    🧭 Demo Features:

    • 4 story missions introducing the main conflict

    • Sample bounty contracts

    • First shootout mechanics and dueling system

    • Exploration on horseback

    ❌ Not included in the demo:

    • Free character switching

    • Progression system

    • Local Multiplayer

    • Minigames, dancing, and side activities (available in full game)

    Wishlist the full game now and saddle up for the revolution of the South.

Wishlist now and prepare for a frontier where the bullets sing in dialect and every truth wears a mask.

content_descriptors.notes: Use of alcohol and cigars. Shooting, stabbing people. Use of cannons, machine gun and explosions. Drug smoker in background
